card.name: Verbs reporting adverse event frequency
card.fires_on: The verb (seen, occurred, reported) right after an adverse event or lab finding, just before 'in X% of patients'. Found in warnings and adverse reaction sections of drug labels.

modes.label: occurred / reported
modes.description: Verb after a named reaction or lab change, leading into a percentage of patients.
modes.example: Exfoliative skin reactions of any severity were<< reported>> in 7% of patients.

modes.label: seen
modes.description: Verb 'seen' after a lab abnormality in a trial group, before a patient count.
